questions.stem: What is the difference between a scanning electron microscope (SEM) and a transmission electron microscope (TEM)?

options.text: SEMs have lower resolution than light microscopes; TEMs have the same resolution
TEMs produce 3D images; SEMs produce 2D images
TEMs can view living cells; SEMs cannot
SEMs produce 3D images of surfaces; TEMs produce 2D images of thin slices showing internal structure

questions.explanation: SEMs scan the surface of specimens to produce detailed 3D images of external features. TEMs pass electrons through very thin slices of specimens to reveal the internal structure in 2D, with even higher resolution than SEMs.
